stage: Causal native-goal contact gate qualification, no learning
gate_rationale: Fixed 0.5N forward evidence is 10% of cap; 0.2N all-axis exit is 4% of cap. Three past samples and 80ms entry suppress spikes. 400ms continuous low force retains posture through brief unloading; progression pauses during that dropout. Exit is the original 750ms smoothstep to standing. Four-second smoothstep entry and spherical path are unchanged. Only force history plus internal past command state; no clock/onset/anchor/active flag or future reference enters gate. Persistent zero-force maintained grasp and actual release are not identifiable from force alone; finite hysteresis is a declared assumption, not a contact sensor.

physical.anchor: Once aligned to no-force standing wrist at each actual onset; same anchor/trajectory across three controllers; read only in task/evaluator
physical.clock: Fixed original onset=3, move4s, hold1s, release=8, smoothstep return0.75s in every condition
physical.pulse: Original 4s partner ramp cut off after0.8s; not an artificially large instantaneous force pulse
physical.recovery: Report exactly release+2s for every contact; pulse also continues to its fixed episode end

execution: One no-force anchor reference then fixed15 comparisons serially; sealed test last. Freeze gate and all conditions before model start; no tuning after development. A physical safety boundary stops stage. Preserve failures; only ordinary implementation bugs may be repaired with explicit version records.
